templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for a mutual NDA that lets two parties share confidential information for a stated purpose while protecting it from unauthorized use or disclosure.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA, capturing the purpose, effective date, MNDA term, term of confidentiality, governing law, jurisdiction and party signatures.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for selling and buying cloud software and SaaS products, covering access and use, restrictions, fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Uptime and support commitments for a cloud service, including target uptime, response times and service credits when commitments are missed.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Terms governing how a provider processes personal data on behalf of a customer, including processor and subprocessor roles, security measures and data transfer obligations under privacy laws such as GDPR.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA-compliant terms setting out how a business associate may use, disclose and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to a product agreement covering the use of AI services, including ownership and use of inputs and outputs and restrictions on training with customer data.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for engaging a provider to perform professional services under statements of work (SOWs), covering deliverables, fees, IP ownership, warranties and liability.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms for licensing on-premise or installed software, covering the license grant, restrictions, fees, support, warranties, liability and termination.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Terms for a limited-time trial or pilot of a product so a customer can evaluate it before committing to a full purchase.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Terms for early-access design partners who get to use a pre-release product in exchange for providing feedback to help shape its development.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Terms for business partnerships such as referral, reseller or co-marketing arrangements, covering each party's obligations, trademark use, fees and liability.
